title: List page footer: the record count sits at a 52px left edge; the page-bar promise puts every lead item on one 16px edge
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the milestone acceptance of #35547 (record #37020) on main `305fe60e`.

**Reproduction:** on `showcase_task` (and `showcase_project`), read the left edge of the text 「10 条记录」 in `[data-testid=data-table-summary-lead]`, relative to `record-list-host` (left 256).

**Expected:** 16 ±1, per `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` acceptance[11]. **Actual:** 52. The select-all box and the page-bar tile both read 16.

If the owner accepts the lead-cell placement on purpose, this becomes a re-point of acceptance[11] instead.

QA-source: #37020 · records-forms.list-view-capabilities · acceptance[11]
